title: Claude Code on the web
tldr: Anthropic has made Claude Code, their specialized coding AI, accessible directly via the web, enabling developers to interact with and leverage its capabilities in a browser environment. This release focuses on improving accessibility and streamlining the development workflow for AI-assisted coding tasks.

title: Piloting Claude in Chrome
tldr: Anthropic is piloting a direct integration of Claude into the Chrome browser, allowing users to leverage its AI capabilities without leaving their browsing environment. This initiative aims to enhance productivity and accessibility by embedding advanced conversational AI directly into web workflows.

title: Customize Cowork with plugins
tldr: Anthropic has introduced new customization options for its Cowork platform, enabling users to integrate and manage various plugins to extend its functionality. This update aims to provide a more flexible and tailored experience for collaborative AI workflows.

title: Understand Claude Code’s impact with contribution metrics
tldr: Anthropic has released new contribution metrics for Claude Code, providing developers with insights into the impact and effectiveness of the AI's assistance in coding projects. This feature allows for better understanding and optimization of AI-powered development workflows.

title: Updates to Claude Team
tldr: Anthropic has rolled out updates to its Claude Team platform, introducing new features designed to enhance collaboration and management of AI resources within organizational settings. These improvements aim to streamline team workflows and improve the utility of Claude for group projects.

title: Your favorite work tools are now interactive inside Claude
tldr: Anthropic has launched enhanced interactive tool integration within Claude, enabling users to directly engage with their preferred work tools from within the AI environment. This update signifies a major step towards making Claude a more central and interactive hub for various productivity tasks.

title: Extending Claude’s capabilities with skills and MCP servers
tldr: Anthropic has published details on extending Claude's capabilities through the integration of specialized "skills" and new "MCP servers," providing developers with a robust framework for custom enhancements. This technical guidance outlines architectural approaches for deploying specialized functions and managing increased computational demands.

title: Skills for organizations, partners, the ecosystem
tldr: Anthropic has introduced a comprehensive "skills" framework and directory designed for organizations and partners, fostering an ecosystem for custom AI capabilities and broader integration. This initiative aims to standardize and facilitate the development and deployment of specialized functionalities across various enterprise applications.

title: Automated Reasoning checks rewriting chatbot reference implementation
tldr: AWS introduces a method utilizing automated reasoning to verify the correctness of rewriting chatbot reference implementations, ensuring reliability and adherence to specified logic. This technical approach aims to enhance the safety and predictability of conversational AI systems through rigorous formal verification.

title: Automating Inference Optimizations with NVIDIA TensorRT LLM AutoDeploy
tldr: NVIDIA introduces TensorRT LLM AutoDeploy, a new tool designed to automate the process of optimizing Large Language Model (LLM) inference. This innovation aims to streamline deployment workflows by autonomously applying TensorRT LLM optimizations, significantly enhancing performance and efficiency for developers.

title: Building Prometheus: How Backend Aggregation Enables Gigawatt-Scale AI Clusters
tldr: Meta engineers detail "Prometheus," a novel backend aggregation architecture crucial for enabling gigawatt-scale AI clusters, optimizing resource utilization and data throughput for massive AI training workloads. This infrastructure breakthrough addresses the formidable power and communication challenges inherent in next-generation AI supercomputers.

title: Scale LLM fine-tuning with Hugging Face and Amazon SageMaker AI
tldr: AWS details how to scale large language model fine-tuning processes using the combined power of Hugging Face libraries and Amazon SageMaker AI, providing a robust, distributed environment for efficient model adaptation. This technical guide covers infrastructure configurations and best practices for optimizing computational resources for LLM customization.

title: Accelerate agentic application development with a full-stack starter template for Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
tldr: AWS has released a full-stack starter template for Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, designed to significantly accelerate the development of agentic AI applications. This template provides a structured foundation, enabling developers to quickly build and deploy intelligent agents leveraging Bedrock's foundational models.

title: Agent-to-agent collaboration: Using Amazon Nova 2 Lite and Amazon Nova Act for multi-agent systems
tldr: AWS details methodologies for enabling robust agent-to-agent collaboration within multi-agent systems, leveraging Amazon Nova 2 Lite and Amazon Nova Act foundational models. This technical guidance explores architectural patterns and interaction protocols for orchestrating complex tasks among autonomous AI entities.

title: Transformers.js v4 Preview: Now Available on NPM!
tldr: Hugging Face has released a preview of Transformers.js v4, now available on NPM, significantly advancing the capability to run transformer models directly within JavaScript environments. This update offers enhanced performance and broader model compatibility, facilitating on-device and client-side AI inference.

title: Structured outputs on Amazon Bedrock: Schema-compliant AI responses
tldr: Amazon Bedrock now supports generating structured outputs, enabling AI models to produce responses that strictly adhere to predefined schemas, enhancing reliability and downstream process integration. This feature is critical for developers needing predictable and parsable data from generative AI models.

title: Manage Amazon SageMaker HyperPod clusters using the HyperPod CLI and SDK
tldr: AWS has enhanced the management capabilities for Amazon SageMaker HyperPod clusters, introducing comprehensive CLI and SDK support for easier provisioning, monitoring, and scaling of distributed training environments. This update streamlines the operational workflow for large-scale machine learning experiments and model development.

title: Evaluate generative AI models with an Amazon Nova rubric-based LLM judge on Amazon SageMaker AI (Part 2)
tldr: AWS elaborates on evaluating generative AI models using an Amazon Nova rubric-based LLM judge within Amazon SageMaker AI, detailing advanced methodologies for automated quality assessment. This Part 2 discusses sophisticated techniques for defining rubrics and interpreting LLM-driven evaluations to refine generative model performance.

title: 3 Ways NVFP4 Accelerates AI Training and Inference
tldr: NVIDIA details how its new NVFP4 format significantly accelerates both AI training and inference tasks. The article explores three key mechanisms through which this low-precision format boosts computational efficiency and throughput on NVIDIA hardware.

title: Making AI work for everyone, everywhere: our approach to localization
tldr: OpenAI details its comprehensive technical strategy for global AI localization, focusing on developing and adapting models for diverse linguistic and cultural contexts. The approach covers advanced multilingual training techniques, efficient resource management, and maintaining high performance across various locales.

title: A practical guide to Amazon Nova Multimodal Embeddings
tldr: AWS provides a practical guide to leveraging Amazon Nova Multimodal Embeddings, detailing their technical application for cross-modal search, retrieval, and similarity tasks. This resource delves into effective strategies for generating and utilizing these advanced embeddings across various data types.

title: How to Build License-Compliant Synthetic Data Pipelines for AI Model Distillation
tldr: This article outlines methodologies for constructing synthetic data pipelines specifically designed for AI model distillation while ensuring license compliance. It details technical considerations and best practices for generating high-quality synthetic data that facilitates efficient model compression.

title: Rethinking imitation learning with Predictive Inverse Dynamics Models
tldr: Microsoft Research presents a novel approach to imitation learning by leveraging Predictive Inverse Dynamics Models, which aims to improve the efficiency and robustness of learning from demonstrations. This research re-evaluates traditional imitation learning paradigms by focusing on predicting actions that lead to desired state transitions.

title: Introducing SyGra Studio
tldr: Hugging Face, in collaboration with ServiceNow AI, has introduced SyGra Studio, a new development environment designed to streamline the creation and deployment of AI applications. This studio integrates tools for model development, data management, and deployment workflows, catering specifically to enterprise AI solutions.

title: GPT-5 lowers the cost of cell-free protein synthesis
tldr: GPT-5 has demonstrated a significant breakthrough by effectively lowering the cost of cell-free protein synthesis. This achievement leverages the model's advanced capabilities in optimizing complex biological processes and refining experimental design within the biotechnology domain.

title: Introducing OpenAI Frontier
tldr: OpenAI has unveiled 'OpenAI Frontier,' a new strategic initiative or platform aimed at pushing the forefront of AI capabilities. This announcement suggests a focus on foundational research into novel model architectures, emergent intelligence, and the development of highly robust and general AI systems.

title: Paza: Introducing automatic speech recognition benchmarks and models for low resource languages
tldr: Microsoft Research unveils Paza, a new set of automatic speech recognition benchmarks and models specifically designed to address the challenges of low-resource languages. This initiative aims to advance inclusive AI by providing crucial resources for developing robust ASR systems where data scarcity is a significant hurdle.

title: GPT-5.3-Codex System Card
tldr: OpenAI has released the GPT-5.3-Codex System Card, providing a deep technical overview of the model's architecture, training methodology, and comprehensive performance benchmarks. It meticulously details safety evaluations, ethical considerations, and real-world deployment challenges pertinent to its code generation capabilities.

title: Introducing GPT-5.3-Codex
tldr: OpenAI has launched GPT-5.3-Codex, an advanced large language model specifically engineered for superior code generation and comprehension. This iteration introduces enhanced programming capabilities, improved assistance for debugging, and expanded language support, marking a significant step forward in AI-assisted development.

title: How to Build a Document Processing Pipeline for RAG with Nemotron
tldr: This article details the construction of robust document processing pipelines specifically tailored for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems utilizing NVIDIA's Nemotron models. It covers technical considerations for data preparation, indexing, and integration to optimize RAG performance.

title: Nemotron ColEmbed V2: Raising the Bar for Multimodal Retrieval with ViDoRe V3’s Top Model
tldr: NVIDIA and Hugging Face announce Nemotron ColEmbed V2, significantly enhancing multimodal retrieval capabilities by integrating ViDoRe V3's top-performing model. This release pushes the state-of-the-art in efficiently searching and retrieving information across diverse data modalities, including visual and textual content.

title: Unlocking the Codex harness: how we built the App Server
tldr: This engineering blog post delves into the intricate technical challenges and innovative solutions employed in building the App Server to efficiently deploy and scale Codex models. It offers insights into critical architectural decisions, optimization strategies, and robust infrastructure considerations necessary for delivering reliable code generation services.

title: Community Evals: Because we're done trusting black-box leaderboards over the community
tldr: Hugging Face has launched "Community Evals," a new framework for transparent, community-driven evaluation of AI models, challenging the limitations of opaque leaderboards. This initiative fosters more robust and trustworthy model assessment by decentralizing evaluation and leveraging collective intelligence.

title: H Company's new Holo2 model takes the lead in UI Localization
tldr: H Company has unveiled its new Holo2 model, a 235B-parameter AI that demonstrates leading performance in UI localization tasks, significantly improving the automation and accuracy of translating and adapting user interfaces. This model represents a leap in applying large language models to complex localization challenges.

title: Accelerating Long-Context Model Training in JAX and XLA
tldr: The blog post explores advanced techniques for significantly accelerating the training of long-context AI models within the JAX and XLA ecosystems. It delves into memory and computation optimizations crucial for efficiently handling extended sequence lengths.
